speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing frequent nosebleeds, bleeding from your mouth, and small red spots on your skin; have you noticed if these occur after minor bumps or do they happen spontaneously?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP).

The clinical picture of spontaneous mucosal bleeding, petechiae, and bruising in a 4-year-old male is highly suggestive of thrombocytopenia. I need to confirm the platelet count before finalizing the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential and platelet count.
